# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(xgboost)
  library(dplyr)
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR   <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT <- normalizePath(file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, ".."), mustWork = FALSE)

OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
XGB_DIR    <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "xgBoost_outputs")
MODEL_DIR  <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "models")
PRED_DIR   <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictions")

run_name <- "xgBoost_aggregated_noLOCTO"

data_file      <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "data_aggregated.tsv")
training_file  <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", "eqtl_files", "training_data_snppg_aggregated.tsv.gz")
predictor_file <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictors_aggregated.txt")
duplicates_file <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "drop_duplicates_aggregated.txt")

model_dir <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, run_name)
pred_dir  <- file.path(PRED_DIR,  run_name)
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(pred_dir,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

feat_out <- file.path(model_dir, "feature_names.txt")
outfile  <- file.path(pred_dir, paste0(run_name, ".tsv"))

plot_path <- file.path(dirname(outfile), "cv_curves_combined.png")
evaluationlog_path <- file.path(dirname(outfile), "evaluationlog.rds")
```

# 2. Preparation
```{r}
full_data <- fread(data_file)
training_data <- fread(training_file)
```

# 3.
```{r}
ct_map <- c(
  Ast = "astrocytes",
  MG  = "Microglia",
  OD  = "Oligodendrocytes",
  OPC = "OPC",
  IN  = "Neurons",     # fuse IN  → Neurons
  Ext = "Neurons",     # fuse Ext → Neurons
  End = "Endothelial"
)

remap_ct <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% names(ct_map), ct_map[x], x)

training_data[, celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]
full_data[,     celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]

# Merge on full identity
#index_cols <- c("peak", "gene", "celltype", "snp", "chr")
index_cols <- c("peak", "gene", "celltype")
setkeyv(full_data, index_cols)
setkeyv(training_data, index_cols)
data <- full_data[training_data, nomatch = 0L]

# Labels: 1 = pos, 2 = strong neg -> make 0/1
data[label == 2L, label := 0L]
data <- data[label %in% c(0L, 1L)]

cat(sprintf("Number of training instances: %s\n", nrow(data)))
cat(sprintf("Number of positives: %s\n", sum(data$label == 1L)))
cat(sprintf("Number of negatives: %s\n\n", sum(data$label == 0L)))

```

```{r}
# Subset to genes with a positive link in the merged set
positive_genes = unique(data[data$label == 1,]$gene)
data = data[data$gene %in% positive_genes,]

# Order data
positive_set = data[data$label == 1,]
negative_set = data[data$label == 0,]
data = rbind(positive_set, negative_set)

writeLines(sprintf("Number of training instances: %s", nrow(data)))
writeLines(sprintf("Number of positives: %s", sum(data$label)))
writeLines(sprintf("Number of negatives: %s\n", nrow(data) - sum(data$positive)))

if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    writeLines("No overlap between candidate links and training data! Halting.")
    quit()
    }

# Read in names of predictors to use in model (should correspond to column names)
predictors = read.table(predictor_file)$V1
writeLines(sprintf("Using %s features for model training and prediction.\n", length(predictors)))

# Create data matrix and training labels
annotation_feature_tabb <- data[, ..predictors]
labels = data$label

LOO_colname <- "chr"

chromosomes <- unique(full_data[[LOO_colname]])


predictions = data.frame()
cv_curves <- list()
evaluation <- data.table()

for (chrom in chromosomes) {
    writeLines(sprintf("Chromosome %s:", chrom))
    # Subset features and training labels to off-chromosome candidate links
    training_idx = which(data[, ..LOO_colname] != chrom)
    training_data = annotation_feature_tabb[training_idx, ]
    training_labels = labels[training_idx]
    writeLines(sprintf("Number of training instances: %s", length(training_labels)))
    writeLines(sprintf("Number of positives: %s", sum(training_labels)))
    writeLines(sprintf("Number of negatives: %s", length(training_labels) - sum(training_labels)))
    
    # Train pgBoost model on off-chromosome data
    NUMITER_XGBoost=1000
    bstSparse <-  xgboost(data = as.matrix(training_data),
                          label = training_labels,
                          max_depth = c(10, 15, 25),
                          learning_rate = 0.05,
                          gamma = 10,
                          min_child_weight = c(6, 8, 10),
                          nthread = 2,
                          scale_pos_weight = 1,
                          subsample = c(0.6, 0.8, 1),
                          nrounds = NUMITER_XGBoost,
                          objective = "binary:logistic",
                          eval_metric = "auc",
                          verbose = 0
    )
    
    # Generate predictions for candidate links on the focal chromosome
    prediction_idx = which(full_data[, ..LOO_colname] == chrom)
    prediction_features = full_data[prediction_idx, ..predictors]
    xgBoost_probability = predict(bstSparse, as.matrix(prediction_features))
    chrom_predictions = cbind(full_data[prediction_idx, ..index_cols], xgBoost_probability)
    
    # Add predictions from focal chromosome to full set of predictions
    predictions = rbind(predictions, chrom_predictions)
    writeLines(sprintf("Number of scored links: %s\n", nrow(chrom_predictions)))
    
      # --- Store CV curves ---
    e <- bstSparse$evaluation_log
    e$chrom <- chrom
    cv_curves[[chrom]] <- e
    evaluation <- rbind(evaluation, e, fill = TRUE)
}

predictions = predictions %>% mutate(pgBoost_percentile = percent_rank(predictions$xgBoost_probability))

# Save predictions to specified outfile name
write.table(predictions, outfile, sep = "\t", row.names = F, quote = F)
writeLines(sprintf("Total number of scored links: %s", nrow(predictions)))
saveRDS(evaluation, evaluationlog_path)

```
